answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 32350 Country: India Title: Iddat Time Question: My Grandfather expire on 5th January 2011 at 9 P.M. so please tell me when my grand mother come out from IDDAT? Answer ID: 32350 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 927/588/L=1432) On 5th of January 2011, at 9:00 pm (evening) it was the first day of Safar 1432 Hijrah. According to it, the iddah of your grandmother ended on 10th of Jumad al-Sania 1432 Hijri corresponding 14th of May 2011, at 9:00 pm (evening). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
